sources.content:
Complaint: My mobile data is very slow since this morning. Pages and apps take a long time to load. The issue affects normal service use. Please help me identify what to do next.
Resolution: Check signal availability and whether the issue occurs consistently, restart the device, retry the connection, and collect time/location details if the slowdown continues.
Previous troubleshooting: Not stated
